items.name: Basic Quiver
items.description: A reusable quiver selecting ordinary physical shots. Shooting never consumes ammunition.

items.name: Hunter's Quiver
items.description: A reusable hunting quiver. Adds 3 raw ranging damage. Shooting never consumes ammunition.

items.name: Bodkin Quiver
items.description: A reusable quiver of armor-piercing shots. Reduces raw ranging damage by 2; each hit has a 25% chance to bypass armor. Shooting never consumes ammunition.

items.name: Farshot Quiver
items.description: A reusable flight quiver. Reduces distance damage loss by 25%; maximum range still depends on Ranging level. Shooting never consumes ammunition.

items.name: Skirmisher's Quiver
items.description: A reusable close-combat quiver. Relieves melee ranging accuracy and damage penalties by 10 percentage points each. Shooting never consumes ammunition.

items.name: Ember Quiver
items.description: A reusable ember quiver. Converts 30% of raw ranging damage to heat, resisted by heat protection. Shooting never consumes ammunition.

items.name: Frost Quiver
items.description: A reusable frost quiver. Converts 30% of raw ranging damage to cold, resisted by cold protection. Shooting never consumes ammunition.

items.name: Arcane Quiver
items.description: A reusable arcane quiver. Converts 30% of raw ranging damage to magic, resisted by magic protection. Shooting never consumes ammunition.
